seoTitle: Best Email Signature Generators (2026): 9 Tools Compared
metaDescription: An honest comparison of 9 email signature generators: HubSpot, WiseStamp, MySignature, Exclaimer, Canva and more. Prices, free options, sign-up and brand import, checked October 2026.
heading: The Best Email Signature Generators in 2026
shortAnswer: For one free signature with no account, HubSpot's generator is the simplest. For company-wide signatures managed by IT, Exclaimer or CodeTwo. For banner campaigns and analytics, WiseStamp or Newoldstamp. If you want your logo and brand colours filled in from your website and would rather pay once than subscribe, our generator does that for {{price}} once. We built it, so weigh that accordingly.
intro: Most email signature generators look alike from the outside: pick a template, type your details, copy. The differences are in what is free, whether you need an account, whether you are signing up to a subscription, and how much work it takes to get your own logo and colours in. We checked each tool's own pricing and product pages on the date below.
method: Every price, plan and feature comes from the vendor's own pricing or product page, linked in the sources column, on the check date shown.
We list the cheapest plan that lets you use a signature, in the currency the page shows.

Brand import means filling in your logo and colours from a website address. We looked for it on every tool's product and pricing pages. No other tool documented it; that is absence of evidence, not proof it does not exist.
We make one of these tools. It is listed with the same columns as everyone else and its limits are stated.

faqs.q: What is the best free email signature generator?
faqs.a: HubSpot's generator is the best fully free option: no account, no paid plan and HTML you can copy. Its limits are a small template set and no way to pull in your logo from your website, so you need your logo hosted at a public image URL first.

faqs.q: Is there an email signature generator without a subscription?
faqs.a: Yes. HubSpot's generator is free with no plan at all. Our generator is a one-time payment of {{price}} with no renewal. Most other tools, including WiseStamp, MySignature, Newoldstamp, Exclaimer and CodeTwo, are subscriptions, and some stop your signature working when the subscription ends.

faqs.q: Which email signature generator can use my company website?
faqs.a: Our generator is the only one we found that documents filling in your logo, brand colours, company name, phone and social links from a typed website address. Other tools ask you to upload a logo or paste an image URL and choose colours by hand. Sites that block automated requests may still need manual entry.

faqs.q: Do I need a signature management platform or just a generator?
faqs.a: A generator is enough for individuals and small teams who install their own signatures. Choose a management platform such as Exclaimer or CodeTwo when IT needs to apply and update signatures for every mailbox centrally, or when legal wording must be enforced.

faqs.q: Are image-based email signatures a good idea?
faqs.a: Usually not. Many email clients block images until the recipient allows them, so an image-only signature can arrive blank or as an attachment, and the text cannot be selected or tapped. HTML signatures with real text and a small logo are more reliable.
